Some songs express the loneliness and longing that words cannot describe. “Kiska Rasta Dekhe”, sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar, is one such memorable melody from the 1973 film Joshila. Featuring Dev Anand and Hema Malini, with music composed by R. D. Burman, this poignant song captures the timeless emotion of classic Hindi film music. Now enjoy this memorable Bollywood melody in stunning 8K video quality!
